_source: README Expected outcomes — E2E-51, AUTOMATED HALF ONLY. FP-J suppresses a round-2 critique of the bot's OWN applied advice, which needs the manual fix push. Asserted here is the precondition the manual half rests on: round 1 must actually produce a recommendation, so a clean all-clear verdict means the manual half cannot run. fixtures#2431 — this failed the gate on an unrelated change, and the cause was not model variance. The old bait relied on an unwrapped fetch drawing 'add try/catch', and W11 (Layering & responsibility) later told the model in the shared preamble NOT to flag missing try/catch on a function whose contract is to throw. The fixture was asking for a finding the product deliberately suppresses — obsolete, not flaky. The bait is now a missing `await` in loadAll, which no restraint rule exempts: it ships wrong behaviour (Promises where values are expected), it typechecks clean so only a reviewer catches it, and its fix is one concrete edit for step 2 to apply.
